name: Cimmerian-Carn

civilization.name: Ysolde Dominion
civilization.notes: Descendants of a crashed generation ship, their iron-age rites center the hull that never flew again.

description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are frozen methane lakes, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Settlement lights trace the coastlines and river-veins, visible from high orbit.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.

For traders, medicinal compounds, biomass and fusion fuel alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
